@deskPairDomainChecking.description: Pairing window, desktop and phone: the title while the wallet checks the domain the new contact claims (up to 8 seconds), before it shows Verified or the four words. {domain} is the domain, e.g. shop.example.

deskPairDomainCheckingBody: {name} says it runs {domain}. If the domain confirms it, there are no words to compare.

@deskPairDomainCheckingBody.description: Pairing window: the line under that title. {name} is the contact's name, {domain} the domain it claims.

deskPairDomainVerifiedBody: {domain} confirms this is {name}’s wallet. No words to compare.

@deskPairDomainVerifiedBody.description: Pairing window: the line under the Verified title when the contact's domain proved its wallet, so the four words were not needed.
